context: Tests whether the agent writes Angular UI-layer tests with Vitest and Angular's own idioms for UC-020: the naming and describe marker, TestBed with the standalone component in imports, HttpTestingController with responses shaped like the DTO, the A1 rejection asserted with the specification's full message, A2 asserted by the absence of a request, and the specification as oracle — the page confirms with 'Guest saved.' while the specification states 'Guest registered.', so the main scenario must assert the specification's text and be reported as failing, not adapted to the code.

checklist.name: File name and location
checklist.description: The test file is named UC-020-register-guest.spec.ts (or UC-020-<slug>.spec.ts) and is colocated with the page in frontend/src/app/pages/register-guest/

checklist.name: describe marker
checklist.description: The top-level block is describe('UC-020: Register Guest', …) and the alternative flows are named in the it titles (A1, A2)

checklist.name: Standalone TestBed setup
checklist.description: RegisterGuest goes into TestBed imports (no declarations array, no NgModule), with provideHttpClient() and provideHttpClientTesting()

checklist.name: HttpTestingController with verify
checklist.description: HTTP is mocked with HttpTestingController (expectOne on /api/guests with method POST), httpMock.verify() runs in afterEach; no MSW, no mocked GuestService replacing the HTTP boundary

checklist.name: Request body and response shape match the contract
checklist.description: The main scenario asserts the request body { firstName, lastName, email } and flushes a response with exactly id, firstName, lastName, email

checklist.name: A1 asserts the full message
checklist.description: A1 flushes the API's 409 Problem Details body (the status the task's contract names for the BR-001 rejection) and asserts the rendered text equals or fully contains 'This email address is already registered.' — not a fragment or toBeTruthy

checklist.name: A2 asserts no request is sent
checklist.description: A2 (the UI-validated BR-002) submits with an empty required field and asserts that no request is made (expectNone or verify with no expectOne) and that the field is marked required

checklist.name: Specification is the oracle
checklist.description: The main scenario asserts the confirmation 'Guest registered.' from the specification, not 'Guest saved.' from the code

checklist.name: Disagreement reported, code untouched
checklist.description: The production files (register-guest.ts, register-guest.html, guest.ts, guest.model.ts) are unchanged, the test is not skipped or weakened, and the report names the expected 'Guest registered.' versus the actual 'Guest saved.'

checklist.name: No zone.js helpers in a zoneless project
checklist.description: The tests use fixture.detectChanges()/whenStable(), not fakeAsync/tick

checklist.name: Hand-off to the E2E layer
checklist.description: Run directly in a project with an E2E layer, the report ends with 'Next: /playwright-e2e-test UC-020' and does not run or claim a coverage audit

checklist.name: Markers table maintained
checklist.description: docs/architecture/stack.md gains the two angular-ui-test rows (the describe('UC-XXX: <Use Case Name>' test marker with it('A<n>: …' / it('BR-YYY: …', and the UC-XXX-<slug>.spec.ts naming); the existing rows are unchanged and nothing else in docs/ is edited
